preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(word, str) for word in dictionary)
preconditions.description: Every item in the dictionary is a non-empty string.
The jumble is a non-empty string.

postconditions.expression: all(word in dictionary for word in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every word in the output list exists in the input dictionary.

postconditions.expression: all(len(word) == len(jumble) for word in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every word in the output list has the same length as the jumble.

postconditions.expression: all(sorted(word) == sorted(jumble) for word in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every word in the output list is an anagram of the jumble (same letters, same frequency).

postconditions.expression: all(return_value.index(word) < return_value.index(other) if return_value.index(word) != -1 and return_value.index(other) != -1 else True for word in return_value for other in return_value if word != other)
postconditions.description: The output list preserves the original order of words as they appear in the dictionary.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == sum(1 for word in dictionary if len(word) == len(jumble) and sorted(word) == sorted(jumble))
postconditions.description: The output list contains exactly the words from the dictionary that are anagrams of the jumble, in their original order.
